note: Expected result: most likely nothing passes the sealed exam (Constitution, first page).

attempts.note: Holm correction over this sport's 20 attempts decides; across all sports there are 20 attempts (reported only).

candidates.name: 538-style combination
candidates.reason: All of the 538 ideas at once: margin multiplier, bye bonus, travel, QB adjustment and a playoff ×1.2 (538's published playoff multiplier).
candidates.verdict: Fails the lab: not positive in gate 2 (2020–22: -0.82 pts); pooled +0.07 pts, Holm-adjusted p = 1.000 over 20 attempts.

candidates.name: Plain Elo
candidates.reason: The simplest team rating: win/loss Elo with a fixed home edge, turned into a point spread. Everything else in the Elo family is measured against it.
candidates.verdict: Fails the lab: not positive in gate 2 (2020–22: -0.87 pts); pooled +0.10 pts, Holm-adjusted p = 1.000 over 20 attempts.

candidates.name: + Rest / bye bonus
candidates.reason: Teams coming off a bye have had extra rest and preparation: +25 Elo for a team whose rest is 13+ days (not week 1).
candidates.verdict: Fails the lab: not positive in gate 2 (2020–22: -0.89 pts); pooled +0.12 pts, Holm-adjusted p = 1.000 over 20 attempts.

candidates.name: + Home field that changes over time
candidates.reason: Home-field advantage has shrunk over the years: use the average home margin of the previous three seasons instead of a fixed 65 Elo.
candidates.verdict: Fails the lab: not positive in gate 2 (2020–22: -0.48 pts); pooled +0.09 pts, Holm-adjusted p = 1.000 over 20 attempts.

candidates.name: Plain Elo, slower (K 10)
candidates.reason: Pre-declared variant: ratings that react half as fast.
candidates.verdict: Fails the lab: not positive in gate 2 (2020–22: -0.58 pts); pooled +0.24 pts, Holm-adjusted p = 1.000 over 20 attempts.

candidates.name: Plain Elo, faster (K 30)
candidates.reason: Pre-declared variant: ratings that react 50% faster.
candidates.verdict: Fails the lab: not positive in gate 2 (2020–22: -0.84 pts); pooled -0.04 pts, Holm-adjusted p = 1.000 over 20 attempts.

candidates.name: + Learn from the market line
candidates.reason: Let ratings learn from the market: after each game, update against a 50/50 blend of the Elo spread and the closing line instead of the Elo spread alone. nfelo regresses toward the market; its exact formula is not in its public code, so this uses a plain 50/50 blend.
candidates.verdict: Fails the lab: not positive in gate 2 (2020–22: -0.79 pts); pooled +0.17 pts, Holm-adjusted p = 1.000 over 20 attempts.

candidates.name: + Margin-of-victory multiplier
candidates.reason: Bigger wins should move ratings more, damped when a favourite wins big (538's multiplier ln(margin+1)·2.2/(winner's Elo edge·0.001+2.2)).
candidates.verdict: Fails the lab: not positive in gate 2 (2020–22: -1.04 pts); pooled -0.15 pts, Holm-adjusted p = 1.000 over 20 attempts.

candidates.name: nfelo-style combination
candidates.reason: The nfelo ideas at once: ratings move by the margin versus the spread (K 9.114, log base 10), market-resistant K, learn from the market line, stronger reversion, playoff ×1.1, changing home field, QB adjustment.
candidates.verdict: Fails the lab: not positive in gate 2 (2020–22: -0.69 pts); pooled +0.14 pts, Holm-adjusted p = 1.000 over 20 attempts.

candidates.name: + Playoff boost
candidates.reason: Rating gaps may matter more in the playoffs, when teams play their best: playoff Elo gaps ×1.1.
candidates.verdict: Fails the lab: not positive in gate 2 (2020–22: -0.80 pts); pooled +0.13 pts, Holm-adjusted p = 1.000 over 20 attempts.

candidates.name: + Quarterback adjustment
candidates.reason: Who starts at quarterback matters more than any other player: adjust by 3.3 Elo per point the starter's rolling VALUE is above or below his team's rolling VALUE (538's QB VALUE formula).
candidates.verdict: Fails the lab: not positive in gate 2 (2020–22: -1.00 pts); pooled +0.02 pts, Holm-adjusted p = 1.000 over 20 attempts.

candidates.name: + Market-resistant K
candidates.reason: When the market called a game better than the model, the model should move further: K grows by |model error − market error| / 1.5039 points when the model's error is the larger one.
candidates.verdict: Fails the lab: not positive in gate 2 (2020–22: -0.39 pts); pooled +0.39 pts, Holm-adjusted p = 1.000 over 20 attempts.

candidates.name: + Stronger preseason reversion
candidates.reason: Rosters turn over: pull ratings about halfway (0.5263) back to average each offseason instead of a third, after centering on the league median.
candidates.verdict: Fails the lab: not positive in gate 2 (2020–22: -0.68 pts); pooled +0.35 pts, Holm-adjusted p = 1.000 over 20 attempts.

candidates.name: + Travel distance
candidates.reason: Long trips may cost the travelling team: −4 Elo per 1,000 miles travelled to the game site, for each team.
candidates.verdict: Fails the lab: not positive in gate 2 (2020–22: -0.74 pts); pooled +0.06 pts, Holm-adjusted p = 1.000 over 20 attempts.

candidates.name: Blend of 2: s-3770bfc8 + s-6f3641ca
candidates.reason: Found by search round 1: on 2006–2016 it beat the line by +1.18 pts a game (t = 3.47), positive in all three search periods. Now confirmed on 2017–2024, which the search never saw.
candidates.verdict: Fails the lab: not positive in gate 3 (2023–24: -1.30 pts); pooled +0.14 pts, Holm-adjusted p = 1.000 over 20 attempts.

candidates.name: Blend of 2: s-473e5379 + s-8a5f816b
candidates.reason: Found by search round 1: on 2006–2016 it beat the line by +1.12 pts a game (t = 3.32), positive in all three search periods. Now confirmed on 2017–2024, which the search never saw.
candidates.verdict: Fails the lab: not positive in gate 3 (2023–24: -0.83 pts); pooled +0.01 pts, Holm-adjusted p = 1.000 over 20 attempts.

candidates.name: + EPA per play as efficiency
candidates.reason: Expected points added per play is a steadier measure of offence and defence than raw points per play; map it to points with a fit on 2006–15.
candidates.verdict: Fails the lab: not positive in gate 1 (2017–19: -0.68 pts); pooled -0.78 pts, Holm-adjusted p = 1.000 over 20 attempts.

candidates.name: Pace × efficiency, fast (half-life 4)
candidates.reason: Pre-declared variant: weight recent games more.
candidates.verdict: Fails the lab: not positive in gate 2 (2020–22: -0.75 pts); pooled -0.27 pts, Holm-adjusted p = 1.000 over 20 attempts.

candidates.name: Pace × efficiency, slow (half-life 16)
candidates.reason: Pre-declared variant: weight recent games less.
candidates.verdict: Fails the lab: not positive in gate 1 (2017–19: -0.39 pts); pooled -0.31 pts, Holm-adjusted p = 1.000 over 20 attempts.

candidates.name: Pace × efficiency totals
candidates.reason: Points = plays × points per play for each offence, against the defence it faces: rolling (half-life 8 games) plays per game and points per play, offence and defence, relative to the league, calibrated once on 2006–15.
candidates.verdict: Fails the lab: not positive in gate 1 (2017–19: -0.39 pts); pooled -0.50 pts, Holm-adjusted p = 1.000 over 20 attempts.
